headline: Nibiru, the Primal Being
title: Nibiru, the Primal Being Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Nibiru, the Primal Being. What is it? It is a Level eleven LIGHT Rock hand trap with three thousand attack. What does it do? If your opponent summons five or more monsters in one turn, during the Main Phase you can tribute as many face-up monsters on the field as possible, then summon Nibiru and give your opponent a Primal Being Token. How do you use it? Wait until their fifth summon, then wipe their combo board. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
